company.name: Synthetic Co. (invented, not a real company)

sources.base rates: synthetic universe of the v0.4 survivorship study (same draws); FCF growth compared with revenue growth assumes a constant FCF margin (modelling assumption)
sources.dcf: enterprise DCF with Gordon terminal value (textbook: Koller, Goedhart and Wessels, Valuation; Damodaran, Investment Valuation); end-of-year cash flows
sources.reverse DCF: price as given, solve for the implied growth (Mauboussin and Rappaport, Expectations Investing); Brent root finding on an explicit bracket
sources.sobol: Sobol' (2001); estimators of Saltelli et al. (2010, Comput. Phys. Commun. 181, 259-270) Table 2: first order (b), total order (f) = Jansen (1999); confirmed in the v0.9 review (consistent with SALib) and checked against the analytic Ishigami indices; the first-order estimator uses centred outputs (numerical-stability variant, same estimand, O(1/N) bias)
